name: Cambodia

seo.title: Cambodia travel guide | Pareto Travel
seo.description: A practical Cambodia travel guide covering itinerary ideas, the best months to visit, cuisine, transport, budget, FAQs, and ratings.

overview:
Cambodia feels like it belongs to a bygone era, but in a good way. The temples of Angkor Wat take you way back in time, while Siem Reap has an old Soviet vibe.

We found the Cambodian people earnest and endearing, which made the stories of the genocide all the more jarring.

Our stay lasted just 48 hours, but the tranquility of the temples made time slow down and left a lasting memory.

Angkor Wat is worth a visit on its own; we recommend combining Cambodia with a longer trip through Southeast Asia, such as Malaysia, Thailand or Vietnam.
